nodes.label: block-blind-grep
nodes.desc: PreToolUse hook: block SILENTLY-BLIND recursive greps. Exit 0 = allow, Exit 2 = block (with JSON permissionDecision payload)

nodes.label: block-destructive
nodes.desc: PreToolUse hook (Bash): block destructive commands. Exit 0 = allow, exit 2 = block (with a JSON permission decision).

nodes.label: block-detached-process
nodes.desc: PreToolUse (Bash) hook: an agent never leaves a process running that nobody supervises.

nodes.label: block-duplicate-spec-number
nodes.desc: PreToolUse hook for Write|Edit|Bash: refuse the write that gives a second spec directory a number another spec directory already holds (specs/NNN-name). Exit 0 = allow, exit 2 = block.

nodes.label: block-ingress-drift
nodes.desc: PreToolUse hook for Write|Edit|Bash: refuse the write that mints a public name nobody has ruled. Exit 0 = allow, exit 2 = block (via deny() in _lib.sh).

nodes.label: block-local-path-disclosure
nodes.desc: PreToolUse (Bash) hook: nothing that leaves this machine names a path ON this machine.

nodes.label: block-local-zone-read
nodes.desc: PreToolUse, WALL for the local-only zone (default folder name: .local-only; override with OPERATOR_LOCAL_ZONE, a regex fragment).

nodes.label: block-off-trunk-commit
nodes.desc: PreToolUse hook (Bash): refuse a `git commit` that lands off trunk.

nodes.label: block-sensitive-mcp
nodes.desc: PreToolUse hook for MCP tools: Block or warn on destructive/external-effect MCP calls. Exit 0 = allow, Exit 2 = block.

nodes.label: block-sensitive-write
nodes.desc: PreToolUse hook for Write|Edit: Block writes to credential/config paths. Exit 0 = allow, Exit 2 = block. Every non-zero path is explicit because `set -e` is on.

nodes.label: block-silent-failure
nodes.desc: PreToolUse hook for Write|Edit: refuse a NEW silent-failure site in code. Exit 0 = allow, Exit 2 = block.

nodes.label: checkpoint-before-change
nodes.desc: PreToolUse hook (Write | Edit | Bash): the LOCAL half of a blocker gate.

nodes.label: conflict-check
nodes.desc: PreToolUse hook: Auto-check file-scope conflicts before edits Automatic owned_paths conflict detection for non-conflicting work Only fires on Write/Edit tools

nodes.label: execute-now-stop-gate

nodes.label: memory-index-cap-guard
nodes.desc: PostToolUse (Write|Edit), the vault index byte cap, checked at WRITE time.

nodes.desc: SessionStart hook: surface the project constitution (if any) and print ONE status line that says which optional parts of operator-os are configured.

nodes.desc: PostToolUse hook: TypeScript type check after file edits Reports errors but does not block (exit 0)

nodes.desc: Stop hook: no turn ends with a vault write that only exists on this machine.
